name: Value Defi
fix_description: In _deposit(), the earn() call makes external interactions before the share calculation and minting are complete. Add nonReentrant modifier or move earn() after _mint, or use a pre-computed balance snapshot to prevent cross-contract reentrancy from manipulating the share calculation.
difficulty_reasoning: The PoC is essentially a one-call replay of the exploit using a crafted calldata blob and a forked state, with no flash loan logic, swap routing, or multi-contract attack orchestration in the test itself. While understanding the root cause may require protocol-specific analysis of Alpaca/worker behavior, writing this PoC from the exploit transaction would be quick for an experienced auditor.
